items.label: text
items.text: TheHenderson-Hasselbalch equation canalsobe used to calculatethepHofabuffersolution.

items.label: text
items.text: For a weak acid, HA, and its conjugate base, A, the following equationapplies:

items.label: formula
items.text: [H⁺(aq)] = Ka × [HA(aq)] / [A⁻(aq)]

items.label: text
items.text: concentrations atequilibrium.However it isreasonabletotakethe original concentrations, for reasons we have already discussed.

items.text: TheoriginalconcentrationofA-will bethesameasthatofthe salt,provided thatasodiumorpotassiumsalthasbeenused.The equationcannowberewrittenas:

items.text: [H⁺(aq)] = Ka × [acid] / [salt]

items.label: text
items.text: Ifwe take thelogarithm tobase 10 of both sides of this equation weget:

items.label: formula
items.text:
lg [H⁺(aq)]  = lg Ka + lg ([acid]/[salt])
Or:
−lg [H⁺(aq)] = − lg Ka − lg ([acid]/[salt])
Or:
pH = pKa − lg ([acid]/[salt])
Or:
pH = pKa + lg ([salt]/[acid])

items.label: text
items.text: This last equation is themost common form of the HendersonHasselbalch equation.
